page.layout: One page of text, one column. Decorative headpiece at the top (no text). Centred dedication title block: italic line, large spaced capitals, spaced capitals, and the royal style in mixed italic and roman. Below it, the greeting "Serenissime REX," and the body paragraph with a woodcut initial P. No margin notes, no running head, no page number, no catchword.

main_text.head: Serenissimo & Potentissimo Monarchæ CAROLO SECUNDO, Dei Gratia Magnæ Britanniæ Franciæ & Hiberniæ Regi, Fidei Defensori, &c.
main_text.p: PRodeat jam sub Tuis Auspiciis Illa Patris Tui Gloriosissimi Imago, Illa quâ magis ad Dei similitudinem quam quà Rex aut Homo accedit. A prode-

page.notes: The large initial P is a woodcut. It is joined to the first word as "PRodeat". The title block is set in large spaced capitals, so the CAROLO line is printed in capitals. The line "Serenissime REX," is treated as a greeting, not a heading. The page ends mid-word at "prode-", so the paragraph continues on the next page.
